prompt: This sheet file references the base files of SR 50 (W Colonial Drive): ALGNRD01.rdraft (attached as ALI), DSGNRD01.rdraft (attached as COR). The centerline is alignment CL1, reached as ALI:CL1. Lay out the plan sheets for CL1 from STA 472+00.00 to STA 490+00.00 at 1" = 50' on the FDOT 11 x 17 plan sheet border (ANSI B, title block template fdot). You decide how many sheets, where to break between them and how to turn each viewport: on every sheet CL1's stationing must read left to right, each sheet's viewport must stay inside its border, and every station from 472+00.00 to 490+00.00 must show on a sheet. Use no more sheets than the stretch needs. At each break between two of your sheets, draw a match line on both sheets, square to CL1 at the break station and running at least 40 ft past the centerline on each side, and letter it along the line MATCH LINE STA followed by the break station to the hundredth (MATCH LINE STA 12+34.56), the same on both sheets. 472+00.00 and 490+00.00 are the limits of this work: no match lines there.
detail: 3 sheets at 1" = 50' on the fdot border (the stretch needs 2), every station shown, stationing left to right on each, match lines square and lettered alike at 478+00.00, 484+00.00
